name: Midtone Miss
description: A brand engineered to FAIL the fail-closed gate: its primary solid is pinned to the mid-lightness 500 stop, a luminance dead zone where neither a light nor a dark label reaches WCAG AA for normal button text (scanner-measured light 3.47:1, dark 4.00:1 - both below 4.5:1). The recipe must name the on-primary pair and refuse to emit a palette.
